1#main: A mourner on the first day is forbidden to put on tefillin. And it contains 2 seifim. A mourner is forbidden to put on tefillin on the first day; and after sunrise on the second day he is permitted to put them on.
2#main: It is required for a mourner to settle his mind to intend his heart toward the tefillin so he not divert his attention from them; but at time of eulogy and weeping he does not put them on.
